buckets.title: NDT
buckets.summary: Comprehensive Non-Destructive Testing and inspection to verify the integrity of welds, materials and fabricated components.
buckets.body: Advantage Marine Services (AMS) offers a comprehensive range of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) and inspection services designed to assess the integrity and reliability of critical components without causing damage. The scope of work covers the provision of NDT inspection services to verify the quality and integrity of welds, materials, and fabricated components. Services include Visual Inspection, Advanced NDT, Conventional NDT, and Material Specification, or other methods as required by the project specifications. AMS employs advanced techniques such as dye penetrant, magnetic particle, eddy current, and ultrasonic testing to detect defects, prevent failures, and ensure compliance with industry standards. All inspections are performed by qualified and certified personnel in accordance with applicable codes, standards, and client requirements, with complete documentation including inspection reports, weld maps, and records of personnel and equipment certifications. These solutions are essential for maintaining safety, performance, and regulatory compliance across marine, offshore, and industrial environments.
capabilities: Tubular & Heat Exchanger Inspection: IRIS, Remote Field Testing (RFT), Magnetic Flux Leakage Testing (MFLT), Near Field Testing (NFT), Advanced Eddy Current Testing (ECT), Video/Remote Visual Inspection (RVI/Borescope)

Material Characterization: Positive Material Identification (PMI) XRF/Optical Emission, Hardness Testing, Ferrite Testing, Corrosion Mapping (PAUT), Replica Metallography, Coating Thickness Measurement (DFT)
Leak & Pressure Testing: Vacuum Box Testing (VBT), Helium Leak Testing (HLT), Bubble Leak Testing (BLT), Pressure Drop/Decay Testing
Conventional NDT: Visual Testing (VT), Radiographic Testing (RT), Ultrasonic Testing (UT), Magnetic Particle Testing (MT/MPI), Liquid/Dye Penetrant Testing (PT/DPI), Eddy Current Testing (ECT)

Advanced NDT: Phased Array Ultrasonic Testing (PAUT), Time of Flight Diffraction (TOFD), Digital Radiography (CR, DDA), Guided Wave Testing (GWT/LRUT), Shear Wave Ultrasonics (SWUT), Acoustic Emission Testing (AET), Infrared Thermography (IRT), Computed Tomography (CT), Electromagnetic Acoustic Transducer (EMAT)
Radiographic Inspection: Conventional and advanced, Ir-192/X-ray, competence person with JPK & AELB, qualified for ASME U-Stamp

buckets.title: Engineering & Steelwork

buckets.body: Advantage Marine Services (AMS) offers a comprehensive range of engineering and steelwork solutions designed to meet diverse project requirements across the marine, offshore, and industrial sectors. Our Engineering & Steelwork team promotes company services to a wider client base and provides the expertise and quality of works to meet client expectation and satisfaction. Our scope covers Engineering Design, Analysis, Structure and Pipe fabrication, Structure and Pipe Repair Works, Blasting and Painting Works, and Mechanical and Electrical Works. Engineering and steelwork frequently collaborate with other departments in full-range scopes such as Special Periodical Survey (SPS) and Engineering Procurement and Construction (EPC). For the last few years, we have successfully completed various kinds of steelwork jobs both inshore and offshore.

specialty.body: Advantage Marine Services (AMS) is an IRATA Member Company specializing in safe and efficient rope access operations for inspection, repair, mechanical, rigging, and maintenance scopes across both onshore and offshore environments. specialty.title: Salvage Works
specialty.body: Advantage Marine Services (AMS) provides professional marine salvage solutions encompassing the rescue, recovery, repair, and refloating of vessels, cargo, crew, and associated properties from unforeseen or imminent peril. Our Salvage Works team combines technical expertise, rapid response capability, and specialized marine engineering knowledge to manage complex and high-risk operations effectively. Salvage operations are often time-sensitive and demanding, requiring immediate mobilization and the use of advanced equipment, proven methodologies, and precise coordination to minimize environmental impact and financial loss. AMS is equipped to handle a wide range of salvage scenarios, from partial recoveries to full-scale refloating and restoration efforts, ensuring safety, efficiency, and compliance with maritime regulations.
capabilities: Ensuring the safety of maritime navigation
Minimizing environmental impact caused by sunken vessels or underwater obstructions

specialty.title: Impressed Current Cathodic Protection (ICCP)
specialty.body: Advantage Marine Services (AMS) delivers reliable Impressed Current Cathodic Protection (ICCP) and Sacrificial Anode Systems designed to prevent corrosion and extend the service life of marine and offshore structures. These systems provide essential protection for hulls, subsea pipelines, platforms and other submerged assets exposed to harsh marine environments. Through the use of controlled electrical currents or sacrificial anodes, AMS ensures effective corrosion mitigation by reducing the electrochemical reactions that cause metal deterioration. Our team offers complete solutions from design, installation, and commissioning to inspection, maintenance and system performance monitoring, ensuring long-term asset integrity and compliance with international standards.
capabilities: ICCP system installation for rigs, ships, FSOs, and FSUs
Sacrificial anode installation for rigs and FSOs
Jetty sacrificial anode installation
Design, supply, and retrofitting
Underwater and topside installation
Compliant with DNV, ABS and industry standards

Designed with robust engineering and precision control, it enhances productivity and minimizes operational downtime across marine, offshore, and industrial environments.
